target: Apple iOS16.5 (20F66), iPhone10,3/iPhone10,6 arm64 shared cache

source_reference.role: AppleARMBacklight service/property contract; independently corroborated against local20F66 binary. Qualcomm DSI command path is not reused.

evidence.fact: IOObjectConformsTo(service,"AppleARMBacklight"), class literal at0x1af0e46b0; stub0x1afb35c1c resolves IOObjectConformsTo.

Builds CFNumberSInt32 brightness=ceil(floatlevel*(max-min))+min; FadePeriod=trunc(seconds*65536); optional backlight-level uses same advertisedrange; sends dictionary with IORegistryEntrySetCFProperties.

evidence.evidence: Sailfish patch0168; matching key string independently located at0x1af0e3a99 in CoreBrightness.

caller_authorization.implementation_policy: Require this boolean entitlement or root administrator; do not require root alone.

implementation.registration: Only when native PWM prerequisites and readback succeed; actual currentlevel fromEN/duty. No registration for ordinary lab framebuffer.
implementation.fade: Nonnegative signed16.16 seconds; integer arithmetic,16ms timer, retargetfromactualPWM. Readbackfailure stopsfade and disables backlight-control. Publishedvalue is last successfully programmedlevel, not unconfirmedtarget.
implementation.legacy_number_types: Reject OSNumber floating tags31/63 for brightness, FadePeriod and backlight-level before any unsigned numeric conversion. Original Apple SInt32 values remain accepted.

validation: Host integer/fade tests pass; original BKS API -> original backboardd/CoreBrightness -> native PWM verified in220-second synthetic run. See original-bks-build13.json. Physical brightness and onscreen slider gesture remain untested.

container_init.required: Valid IORegistryEntry ID and successful internal dispatch queue allocation
container_init.class_check: AppleARMBacklight marks built-in; other services mark external
container_init.optional_property: kUSBContainerID searched recursively in IOService plane; absence logs but continues at0x1af0675ec

discovery.diagnostic: backlight_probe.c repeats exact matcher plus class matching and reads properties only; no IORegistryEntrySetCFProperties or PWM writes.
discovery.runtime_boundary: Build10 read-only diagnostic found one matching AppleARMBacklight and exact property matcher. Build13 original BKS helper delivered legacy integer requests from original backboardd. Modern metadata-only requests remain rejected; no invented nits conversion.

original_framework_probe.entitlement_reference: Both boolean entitlements observed in original20F66 SpringBoard.
original_framework_probe.restriction: Requires --qemu-lab and exact version/native-io/lab-fixture u32=1 in /chosen/mt6762-handoff.
original_framework_probe.operation: Calls original framework setter with0.25,0.75 and initial logical level; never directly writes IOKit properties or PWM.
original_framework_probe.observations: Logical getter is original BackBoardServices. native log field is last confirmed published IODisplayParameters value, not an independent live hardware read.
original_framework_probe.limitations: Successful Mach IPC alone is insufficient. Correlate original backboardd accepted target with native readback and independent QEMU PWM model counters. Apple idle/blanking policy may override a target.
